method.input: Completed source-matched one-day single-meeting-cue model rehearsal; all roles and actual request reservations.
method.cost_method: Separate startup requests before43200 from requests starting at/after43200. Weighted raw seven-day cost = startup + 7*daily-change cost. Include reported charges and full unknown reservations.
method.request_buffer: Maximum actual single-request reservation in the completed rehearsal.
method.context_method: For each owner/role, measure maximum startup input and maximum input after the cue. Use the maximum startup across owners plus 7*1.5 times the largest positive per-owner post-cue growth, with a1024-token minimum growth. Add the role output ceiling.
method.assistant_input_measurement: Actual AI usage.input_tokens at each saved model step, identified by the saved input-message prefix and its next AI message in the materialized graph state.
method.actor_and_review_input_measurement: Conservative prompt_token_bound from each actual request and its next applied same-owner/role Clock job.
limitations: One social coordination example covers one requester and two respondents, not independent repeated days.
The safety margins are planning rules, not a prediction interval or a budget/completion guarantee.
No untimed context compaction is available in the elapsed profile.
Each request still reserves against the same absolute USD20 campaign.
method.reason_for_two_pairs: Use a smaller declared social rehearsal within the unchanged cumulative USD20 cap; do not claim that it validates the larger three-person medium-chaos setting.

readiness: Complete one-day task but seven-day forecast exceeds the same remaining campaign balance. Do not lower the precommitted margins or increase the ceiling.
